Question ID: SPEECH_U06_L03_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.PRES.01

Which media choice best supports an interview preparation presentation?

answer.text: A. Add media because it looks interesting

feedback.text: This choice is incomplete because it does not support a clear professional or multimedia communication purpose.

answer.text: B. A checklist slide showing interview preparation steps

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports professional communication by connecting clear purpose, source support, media choices, and audience understanding.

answer.text: C. Choose images with no connection to the point

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception. Recheck purpose, audience, source support, or presentation design.

answer.text: D. Put ideas in an order that confuses the audience

feedback.text: This choice weakens communication because it does not help the audience understand the professional message.
